title: OpenDiscoveryTrace：评估AI科学家工作流的流程轨迹数据集
summary: 该论文提出OpenDiscoveryTrace，一个包含558条完整AI科学智能体轨迹的公开数据集，记录模型推理过程而非仅最终输出。轨迹涵盖9字段每步结构化记录（思维、工具调用、观察、错误、修正触发、置信度），覆盖124个科学任务和7个模型。初步分析发现流程轨迹能揭示输出评估无法察觉的行为差异，如Claude Opus 4.6错误数是GPT-5.4的30倍。
summary_en: This paper presents OpenDiscoveryTrace, a public dataset of 558 complete AI scientific agent trajectories that capture reasoning processes rather than just final outputs. Each trajectory records a structured 9-field-per-step trace (thoughts, tool calls, observations, errors, revision triggers, confidence) across 124 scientific tasks and seven models. Pilot analysis reveals process traces expose behavioral differences invisible to output-only evaluation, such as Claude Opus 4.6 producing 30x more errors than GPT-5.4.
